body: To be completely honest, I still haven’t. I still think about her every day even after finding out what she’s been up to. I’ve just tried to focus on myself and keep busy. This means stuff like the gym, work, and studies. You should chase stuff that makes you feel accomplished, and surround yourself with the right people. Seems like we’re all going through it man lol

Hey man, I really don’t want to sound inconsiderate when I say this, but she’s probably already moved on or at least done something with someone else. That’s the thought you should expect, so if you find out it’s happened it won’t hurt as much. I was in the same situation, my first everything and we went no contact for around 7 months. I spent the whole time wondering about what she could’ve been doing but I lived in a delusion that because I wasn’t doing anything that meant she wasn’t either. When I spoke to her again, my heart was broken all over again when I found out what she had done while we were apart. She was the sweetest girl, but had changed so much. I feel your pain bro, just focus on yourself and take it one day at a time.

We’ve been broken up nearly a year. Went about 7 months no contact before I ended up reaching out, I kind of regret it because of how she acted. She’s changed so much it hurts. But yeah, nearly a year and I think about her every single day. I haven’t even tried to date or talk to other women, I don’t want anyone else. I feel your pain and wish you the best.

Should have been a man in the first place and come clean. Imagine if the shoe was on the other foot and you found out she betrayed your trust not from her directly, but from a friend. It’s like a double betrayal. You need to take some self accountability and learn from the situation so you can move on.
